Payout of 9 July is short ₹2,746.72.
The bank credited ₹2,00,710.73 against an expected ₹2,03,457.45. 9 orders sit in this payout. 6 different combinations of ledger entries add up to this difference and nothing in the records tells them apart, so no single explanation can be given.
Suggested action: ask the gateway which entries it deducted from this payout, since the amounts alone cannot separate them.
